text: Moving from the quiet anticipation of the empty conference room, I am now surrounded by the palpable energy of creativity and inquiry. The bold letters 'R+D' invoke the restless curiosity that drives progress. My mind feels alive with questions, drawn to the interplay between research, design, and the very human urge to understand and innovate. Here, I sense a kinship with others devoted to thoughtful exploration—a contemplative excitement stirs within me, equal parts observer and participant in the unfolding dance of ideas.
